rules.title: Microsoft.Azure.DocumentDB is deprecated on NuGet
rules.summary: NuGet marks all 36 listed versions of Microsoft.Azure.DocumentDB as deprecated (reason: Legacy). The publisher's message: "Please note, this package is obsolete as of 3/31/2023 and is no longer maintained or monitored. Microsoft encourages you to upgrade to the replacement package, Microsoft.Azure.Cosmos, to continue receiving updates. Refer to our deprecation policy (https://aka.ms/azsdk/support-policies) for more details."
